about: src/lib/cost_vectors.json is a byte-for-byte copy of madar-shared's file at this tag (madar-money cost: line cost, recipe cost, margin, food-cost band; the backend costs recipes with it). src/lib/recipe-cost.test.ts runs the dashboard's wrappers (the wasm) against it. A change is made there, released with a tag, and copied here with the tag and hash below updated; scripts/check-shared-vectors.sh (CI) and shared_vectors.test.ts check it.
